name: Margaret Glaser
fact: She sat on the Judicial Council as an Associate Justice in 2022-23, under Chief Justice Justin Goins and Associate Chief Justice Isaac King, alongside Colton Ping, Garrett Baum, Ellie Soares and Miles Huff. The archive records her only as a senator-at-large in 2021-22.

src.label: WKU SGA, Judicial Council page, as it stood 4 February 2023 (Wayback Machine)

name: Madison Payne
fact: She sat on the Judicial Council as an Associate Justice in 2024-25, under Chief Justice Ellen Henderson and Associate Chief Justice Morgan Gammons, alongside Neill Kane, Aziz Umarov and Sam Dorris. The archive records her only as a member in 2023-24.

src.label: WKU SGA, Judicial Council page, as it stood 13 November 2024 (Wayback Machine)

name: Justin Goins
fact: He joined the Judicial Council as an Associate Justice in 2021-22, under Chief Justice Holden Schroeder and Associate Chief Justice Turner Reynolds, sitting with Alexis Mayne, Jason Herlick, Abbey Norvell and Nicole Massarone, before becoming Chief Justice the following year.

src.label: WKU SGA, Judicial Council page, as it stood 21 January 2022 (Wayback Machine)

name: Blake Graham
fact: He was already an Associate Justice before he became Chief Justice, sitting under Chief Justice Morgan Gammons with Associate Chief Justice Gavin Grawe, Neill Kane, Aziz Umarov, Hailey Stapleton and Samantha Lein. The archive records him only as Chief Justice in 2025-26.

src.label: WKU SGA, Judicial Council page, as it stood 17 July 2025 (Wayback Machine)

name: Tribhuwan Singh
fact: SGA's own executive branch page gave his name in the short form Trib Singh, listed him as Director of Enrollment and Student Experience with an office at DSU 2046, and recorded that the directors were appointed by a majority of the three elected officers rather than by the president alone.

src.label: WKU SGA, Executive Branch page, 2021-2022 Executive Cabinet, as it stood 21 January 2022 (Wayback Machine)

name: Elizabeth DeLozier
fact: After serving as Secretary of the Senate in 2021-22 she sat in the 2022-23 Senate as the College of Health and Human Services senator, where SGA's own roster spells her surname Delozier.
